children: Acumen Pharmaceuticals will host a live-webcast Investor Day and disclosed that ALTITUDE-AD topline results are expected in late 2026 while an EBD lead candidate IND is targeted for mid-2027.
Investor Day on Sept 16, 2026 will be live-webcast; slides and webcast posted to investor site and attached as Exhibit 99.1.
ALTITUDE-AD Phase 2 (542 pts) is well-powered; topline efficacy, safety and biomarker readout expected late 2026.
Phase 1 sabirnetug (ACU193) showed biomarker improvements and limited ARIA, supporting Phase 2 dose selection (35–50 mg/kg Q4W).
EBD bispecific program (ACU301/ACU401) achieved up to ~40x higher brain exposure in NHPs and supports subcutaneous dosing; IND targeted mid-2027.
Company expects cash resources to be sufficient into early 2027 (forward-looking disclosure in presentation).
